# Original resources for actual narrowing and callback prefixes

Narrowing resources: f77dbe539741b04558eb2db249e1a8d36ae09656.
Prefix resources: 4faaa1cd8699c155dd2e37ad2b7a94d7eea00107.
Callback resources: 63249e5c1d6a3baa9af724630905d9c425fa4dfa.
Base: 38123542e925f232ecae5d5c202646220d04900d.
The branch pull was already up to date. Main remains imported at
153e1a211b56dd78bd22f6b427fb78e673041d55.
The goal stays ACTIVE. The full formalization remains incomplete.

## Strongest claim

H6, SourceCurrentColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls, remains the
strongest end-to-end language theorem. Covered closed construction and valid
constraint-allocation history supply any prescribed finite number of modeled
node-processing rounds. Derived sufficient fuel and one mathematical integer
width chosen after construction give an actual finite trace. Its inherited
payload is empty. The final available value has exactly the original finite-
tree language for every ambient context and term under formal Formula and
Entailment semantics. This does not cover arbitrary mixed calls or the whole
recursive pruning enumerator.

The new results cover actual closed narrowing and the concrete rendered
callback followed by its next accepted selected prefix. The initial numeric
profile and guard predicate bound the same native endpoint that the worker
returns. The producers derive sufficient common fuel. They do not assume a
future successful run, cache, endpoint or capacity.

## Bound the actual narrowed heap

NativeView.narrowAt first calls nodeEdges. It filters the actual returned rows
with keeps, then calls makeNode on that filtered list. The pure fits and
admits functions select whole edges. They create no guard or constructor.

narrowAt_resources uses ProjectionUnionResources.read on the actual successful
read. Its original scalar bounds that same returned heap and literal row
count. The filtered row list has no larger length. Its edges remain resident.
MemoMergeResourceControl.node bounds the actual filtered reconstruction.
The result fits the existing closed EditForecast.headProfile profile.
The head profile retains all original components and the domain bound.
No new forecast definition or cross-alphabet monotonicity is needed.

AnnotationExposure.nodeEdges_heap retains the original arbitrary guard
predicate at the actual read endpoint. AnnotationHeap.run with makeNode
retains it through the filtered reconstruction. OuterNarrow.narrow_resources
adds the actual Mu and type-position skips. Those skips retain the input heap
and fit the conservative head profile.

These low-level theorems observe a supplied actual done equation. They do not
assert completion at every fuel or bound arbitrary failed-fuel heaps.
Completion comes from the existing current-input prefix producer below.

## Retain prefix resources and packets

SelectedStep.Resources names the native endpoint in the actual prefix result.
A narrowed result uses its reached caller. Other result forms use the input
caller. prefix_resources recovers the old handle, read and narrowing equation
from PrefixValid. PendingRealized supplies the old value's availability and
closure. The actual read's representative and handle identify that old value.
The low-level observer then bounds the SAME returned narrowing heap.
advancePhysical preserves the native domain table and equality operations.
The reached caller changes only its constructor heap. Full query, fourth and
merge states remain where the earlier prefix certificate places them.

packet_prefix_complete_resources calls packet_prefix_complete ONCE. It retains
its full earlier PrefixValid output. The same common fuel supports every
larger bound and the actual expansion decision. It adds Resources and the
recursive packet for each retained optional cache. A narrowed cache retains
its own full Post memos and query equation. A parked cache keeps the caller.
Empty rejection has no retained cache packet. Its actual narrowing allocations
and resource bounds remain present. No Safe packet is inferred for rejection.

PrefixValid contains a finish expression that embeds an observation in an
earlier validity proposition. runPrefix does not execute that expression.
The recursive worker does not run the legacy ordinary scan through finish.
The new proof uses that proposition as a certificate for the actual native
prefix endpoint. It does not claim an additional runtime scan.

## Retain the complete callback output

callback_prefix_complete_resources calls callback_prefix_complete ONCE.
The entire earlier output remains the first conjunct under the same
existential fuel, result and core. It retains the returned Packet, RenderStable,
Frame, exact metadata equations, stable actual raw singleton, concrete
continueWith equation and accepted-next-prefix validity.

The appended output adds Resources and the actual returned prefix Packet for
each accepted expansion at every larger common work bound. The callback
itself keeps the native caller and full memos. Its next selected prefix pays
for its own row read and node reconstruction. A full saved memo witness comes
from Post. Equality of the query component does not identify the full memos.
Fits bounds the current counters and stored mass. It supplies no Room for a
later native query. The guard predicate can be an original alphabet carrier.

## Validation and preserved boundaries

All three new modules and Audit pass strict checks with warningAsError and
linter.all enabled. The aggregate Audit build passes 3825 jobs and checks
77331 theorem dependencies. Installed public readback checks 11 declarations
and prints eight complete definitions. Its 850 lines contain 61360 bytes.
SHA256: 74b5bbad3c21e4b8a082222181957bbaec9caa1e4565de05f28619c2e84323bb.
Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound appear in the axiom reports.

Exact output comparisons retain all 406 normalized prefix and 1390 normalized
callback characters. The prefix comparison expands its local observed let.
It normalizes namespace qualification and whitespace only. The callback
comparison retains the complete earlier output body without alteration.
An independent source review is clear for all three final source hashes.

The first prefix strict check failed because namespace imports were missing.
The second failed on domain-bound reduction and a dependent match in the
older packet theorem's result. Explicit profile-growth transport avoids the
reduction. Case analysis on the actual prefix result removes the dependent
match. The third prefix check passes. The narrowing and callback checks pass
on their first attempts. Every failed snapshot and raw report is retained.
No theorem premise or conclusion was weakened to fix these failures.

All heavy checks ran serially under a 4 GiB cap. Every report reads effective
memory.max=memory.high=4294967296 and memory.swap.max=0. The only existing Lean
source edit is one Audit import. Runtime workers, old interfaces and H6 remain
unchanged. No Haskell source changed. No Haskell tests or formatters were run
for this Lean-only change. FINDINGS keeps all six merged Haskell repairs and
the pending Sized documentation repair af6369a9e. No new defect is claimed.

## Next actual recursive integration

The existing shallow alternative producer does not execute recursive hooks.
Its later indexed receipts cannot stand for later siblings in the hook-aware
worker. NativeContinuations.run feeds each hook's actual returned caller and
queries into the suffix. Each sibling still restores its captured enumeration
cache and metadata.

Next complete the actual ordinary continuation with the concrete rendered
callback and resume at depth zero. This is the continuation used inside
resume at depth one. Use the head captured-edge resource producer once per
actual reached alternative. Derive its own Packet and fragment bound. Execute
the callback and interpret the actual restart decision. Done, stuck, stop and
callback pruning complete normally. A new expansion reaches the actual
exhausted stop. Keep that stop and skip the suffix. This executes real native
child work and callbacks without assuming recursive success.

For deeper recursion, reserve narrowing, dynamically reached ordinary scans
and complete recursive subtrees in one original forecast. Thread the actual
post-subtree caller and full memos into each later sibling. Keep each output's
Post at its own emission endpoint and a separate final native Post. Retain
explicit unsupported and exhaustion observations. Do not replace the actual
callback by identityHook or use later legacy scan receipts as hooked receipts.

Whole recursive capacity and whole-driver language remain open. Terminal outer
fallback, native Graph correspondence, concrete solver and physical-container
correspondence, machine integers, extraction, convergence and arbitrary lazy
forcing remain separate obligations. No completion percentage is established.
